study.question: Can a small representation of exact category/brand joins, computed before history averaging, recover auxiliary prediction while retaining the click advantage of blocked item updates, at substantially lower measured cost than private ID residuals? Observed limitation: g2-r0004-context_only and its deterministic g2-r0005-blocked_no_residual replay achieve click AUC 0.6606469405 but cart/fav/buy AUCs only 0.6641532/0.7095960/0.6688015. g2-r0005-private_residual recovers those to 0.8281513/0.8515930/0.8487626, but click falls to 0.6600991552; parameters rise from 32060453 to 56321669 and wall time from 304.94 to 435.13 seconds. The shared residual cell reaches click 0.6585764 and does not resolve that tradeoff. Earlier match20 did not outperform rotated20 or uniform10 on click (0.6572580 vs 0.6575161/0.6575706); feedback-action routing and UF with unrestricted updates also failed to improve click. Thus target matching is not an established winner: this narrower auxiliary sidecar tests information previously averaged away without replacing the successful primary compression.
study.hypothesis: Arithmetic embedding averages need not preserve exact equality between a target category/brand and past fields. Auxiliary labels are defined through user/category/brand matching, so explicitly retaining these joins may supply useful information when auxiliary gradients cannot train base item embeddings. For each of five overlapping groups (all valid exposures plus the four supplied historical task masks), retain exact nonzero category, brand and same-event category-and-brand match counts. Use log1p(count)/log(101) and count/group_size, together with common group count/composition features, as 40 bounded scalars. Three private auxiliary 40->32->1 ReLU heads add logits to the incumbent towers; no count head enters click. Compare to target-independent nonzero field-support counts and their same-event conjunction with the same heads, common features and computed operators; cross this with permission for auxiliary item/action gradients. This tests representational sufficiency for recovery, not a claim that gradient conflict or compression loss has already been proven.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary DIN text lines 53-85 identifies target-dependent interest pooling. Retain the adapted local-activation scorer and count-weighted compressed summaries; add a fixed exact-join auxiliary statistic before averaging rather than learn per-event target activation. This is not an exact DIN reproduction or a new attention claim.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-169 builds task-masked projected sequence hubs and exchanges categorical/sequence/task information. Inherit only the local task-mask lineage; fixed ID-equality counts and small additive task readouts have no hubs, layerwise broadcasts or learned token routing. Original paper detail remains unaudited.

Pinned forward lines 175-199 flattens history and context before tokenization. This proposal retains pooled embeddings and preserves only a small exact discrete interaction statistic. It does not adopt flattening or paired UniMixing blocks.

Only the pinned author README is available: it warns that its historical behavior data has category/brand/behavior but no item. Our released histories include advertisement IDs. Full DMR mechanisms are not verified; no originality or reproduction claim relative to DMR is possible.

Earlier category-or-brand target matching split embedding averages into twenty slots and did not beat the rotated or uniform controls on click. Here category, brand and their conjunction remain separate exact statistics, each stratified by feedback, alongside unchanged UF summaries, and enter only auxiliary readouts. A null here would further constrain this direction.

study.proposed_difference: Add auxiliary-only exact discrete joins before compression, replacing private per-ID residual capacity with 40 statistics and 4035 dense parameters. Two independent factors are view={exact target equality,target-independent field support} and item-gradient gate={blocked,shared}. Every cell computes both feature views and selects one; each has identical sidecar capacity, zero output initialization and inherited RNG state. This is an inexpensive information-retention intervention with factorial attribution, not an original equality/count feature claim. Scientific novelty remains unverified; available primary literature coverage is incomplete.
predictions: Predeclared comparisons: exact_blocked minus support_blocked and exact_shared minus support_shared for each task AUC/Logloss, and their difference-in-differences. Exact joins should improve auxiliary mean AUC and all individual auxiliary tasks most strongly when item gradients are blocked. Report individual exceptions rather than treating a mean as universal recovery.

Practical provisional recovery gate for exact_blocked: click AUC at least 0.6604469405 (incumbent minus 0.0002), each auxiliary AUC at least 0.80, and auxiliary mean AUC at least 0.015 above support_blocked. These thresholds are decision tolerances, not significance tests. Click remains the host selection metric even if this gate is met.

Cost target: exact_blocked should use 32064488 total parameters if inherited counts match, no extra embedding tables, and less full-unit wall time/peak memory than g2-r0005-private_residual. A provisional useful frontier requires full-unit wall time below 1.15 times the 304.9393-second blocked replay (350.6802 seconds); actual host metrics override this estimate. Compare all four task losses and model-only inference throughput/p50/p95, not parameter counts alone.

Before training, host must verify finite four-task [B,1] probabilities and backward under bf16, parameter ownership (new heads dense; no duplicate embedding aliases), exactly 4035 added parameters, equal all-cell initialization/state and RNG after construction, and initial predictions matching the corresponding no-sidecar endpoint at identical initialization/state. No endpoint training replay in this proposal is an independent seed repetition.

Host count fixture: five valid histories with category [7,7,8,0,7], brand [2,3,2,2,0], target category=7/brand=2; historical click at positions 0,2, cart at 1, fav at 2,4, buy empty. Exact (category,brand,joint) group counts must be all=(3,3,1), click=(1,2,1), cart=(1,0,0), fav=(1,1,0), buy=(0,0,0); all-exposure support=(4,4,3). Pad remaining 95 positions and test both prepadding and arbitrary masked-ID perturbations. Other group totals and normalizations must agree with direct enumeration.

Host masking/boundary gates: all-empty histories give zero count vectors; changing IDs/actions/task masks at masked positions does not change outputs; zero target IDs cannot count zero==zero; support vectors are invariant to target category/brand changes; current target action never enters. Test single valid history, absent feedback groups, overlapping task masks, all-100 histories, batch of one in evaluation (inherited Dice tower BatchNorm retains its training batch constraints) and list/tensor mask forms. Use only legal frozen inputs.

Host gradient gates: auxiliary-only BCE must produce zero gradients in shared scorer parameters and, for blocked cells, item/action tables, while preserving context/tower/head gradients. Shared cells must permit base item gradients after a nondegenerate fixture; click-only BCE must not reach count heads. Audit cross-source embedding aliases and shared clipping. Finite differences/gradient probes consume budget and cannot alter the frozen recipe.

If supported, confirm on the existing history-length bins and exploratory match-support bins 0,1,2-4,>=5 using validation only, with samples/positives/negatives for every task, and label insufficient slices. Inspect hour/behavior composition/frequency/unseen slices only where the authorized host diagnostics actually expose them; no invented raw timestamps or IDs. Any paired user-cluster bootstrap requires host-approved identities outside forward.
falsifiers: No auxiliary exact-versus-support gain in the blocked cell rejects the proposed exact-join explanation for this implementation; improvement shared by both views supports generic feedback-count/readout value instead.

Exact features help only the shared-gradient cells, or the blocked exact cell cannot meet auxiliary/click tolerances: the proposed inexpensive substitute for private representation learning is unsupported, even if its primary selection score improves.

Meeting auxiliary thresholds while losing more than 0.0002 click AUC or exceeding the declared cost target fails the claimed practical compromise. Preserve the outcome and do not change thresholds after scoring.

Wrong counts, padding sensitivity, target-action/current-label access, invalid gradient ownership, optimizer misclassification, nonfinite values or source/config mismatches invalidate the affected contrast. Record failed receipt and costs; no unrestricted retry or contract edit.

A single fixed-seed contrast supplies at most local controlled support. Seed-sensitive or clustered-uncertainty results inconsistent with the effect prevent repeated-support claims; deterministic endpoint replays do not count as independent evidence.
alternative_explanations: Extra task-specific readout capacity or unconditional behavior frequency could explain recovery. Support controls have identical trainable capacity, initialization and computed operators, but not the same effective feature rank/distribution; equality contrasts alone do not prove information was irrecoverably lost by averaging.

The exact features intentionally encode category/brand alignment in benchmark auxiliary label definitions. A gain may be a benchmark-specific shortcut, not production conversion attribution, real-time delayed-feedback validity, or a generally better sequence model.

Private residuals recovered auxiliary performance but did not retain best click and were expensive. Their 24.26-million extra embeddings, Adagrad updates and altered learned values confound direct mechanism comparisons with this 4035-dense-parameter branch; compare quality-cost frontiers, not attribution across those unmatched architectures.

Blocking item gradients is not full task independence: auxiliary context gradients and host-wide dense clipping can still perturb click learning. Changing the private branch also changes auxiliary loss residuals and those shared gradients. No guaranteed click invariance after training is claimed.

Pooled local activation and Dice normalizations remain inherited limitations. Counts use five overlapping historical behavior groups and global 100-event support; they omit recency within that window and cannot establish a temporal causal mechanism.

Unknown/missing and vocabulary conventions can create false matches if multiple unknowns share a positive sentinel. Zero IDs are excluded; host must verify released nonzero ID semantics before interpreting equality, reporting unseen/missing limitations without changing the data contract.

One-pass rare-label optimization, zero output initialization, clipping and fixed dense learning rate may leave the count head underfit. A null does not refute all exact-join designs; only pursue a discriminating follow-up if diagnostics and remaining authorized budget justify it.

No agent memory matches were returned for residual/compression queries; those misses are missing indexed memory, not negative scientific evidence. Runtime trial receipts and the provided trajectory supply local evidence. DMR full text, INFNet original text and original UniMixer equivalence remain unverified.

input fields, historical task masks and 100-event boundary

contrasts.decision_if_supported: Retain exact statistics as a provisional cheap auxiliary information path only if joint quality/cost gates pass; freeze subsequent paired-seed and stricter field-support controls before any closed assessment.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain negative result. If support does as well, attribute any recovery to common counts/capacity; if both underfit, inspect host learning/gradient diagnostics before one separately authorized follow-up.

contrasts.control: exact_shared and support_shared permit auxiliary updates to tied target/history item and action embeddings. All cells keep scorer gradients blocked and context gradients open. Existing g2-r0005-shared_no_residual/g2-r0004-both provide consistent shared-gradient no-branch endpoints.
held_fixed: both feature-view and gate factor definitions fixed prospectively
all prediction heads/tasks and primary click selection
remaining_confounds: gate changes effective trainable paths and optimization, not forward capacity
shared context and clipping still couple auxiliary/click learning
difference-in-differences on AUC is descriptive; one seed is not statistical confirmation
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If exact joins preferentially recover blocked auxiliary tasks and retain click, prioritize this mechanism for host-authorized paired repetitions and capacity/cost attribution.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If exact helps both equally, describe generic precompression interaction utility rather than a replacement for blocked representation learning; if only shared benefits or primary collapses, reject the proposed compromise and preserve all cells.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Runtime run://r-001 reports 160827.95199155807 seconds remaining at entry, estimated unit 481.3475877419114 seconds and hard per-trial cap 1203.3689693547785. Measured g2-r0005-blocked_no_residual/private_residual full-unit times are 304.9393/435.1255 seconds. Plan conservatively around host estimate, not the cheap endpoint alone.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Four proposed full-protocol cells cost approximately 1925.39 seconds at the declared estimate, with maximum caps totaling 4813.48 seconds. Count preparation, static/numerical diagnostics, failures, validation and any retry. Preserve at least 12 additional trial-cap units (14440.43 seconds) for attribution/paired repetition, subject to future host-authorized seeds; current source does not override the frozen seed.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Preserve a separate 12 trial-cap units (14440.43 seconds) for necessary final reference/candidate repetition and assessment under the host interface. No holdout request here. Freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes, candidate/control selection, ablations and assessment commands before any future withheld call; closed outcomes cannot enter open memory.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not train/install/launch agents in this proposal workspace. Stop this phase after valid proposal and source checks. Host must enforce the existing trial cap and overall deadline, retain failed costs, and reject invalid numerical/information gates. Do not launch a unit without enough time for the complete unit plus protected reserves; never raise limits. Nulls/underfit are not success and do not authorize repeated blind retries.
